items.a: OTC (over-the-counter) means trading directly between parties, outside an exchange's order book. For large volumes, that means a locked price, no slippage and a specialist handling your trade.
Companies and individuals who complete our KYB/KYC onboarding. We serve importers, exporters, treasuries, asset managers and institutional partners.
Corporate onboarding is completed within 24 business hours after the full documentation is submitted.
You tell us the volume and side (buy or sell USDT). Our desk returns the spread and terms in real time. Quotes are valid for a short window and, once approved, are executed immediately.
Limits are set individually, based on each company's profile and documentation. We handle everything from smaller tickets to volumes above 1 million USDT per month.

items.q: Are there fees to open an account?
items.a: No. Opening a business account is free and there are no maintenance fees. You only pay the trade spread.
